items.text: Siliguri sits inside the "Chicken's Neck" - the narrow corridor of Indian territory bordered by Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh, with Sikkim just to the north, that the entire Northeast's road and rail links to the rest of the country pass through.

That makes Siliguri a genuine multi-nation border-trade and logistics chokepoint, and its role as the road, rail, and air gateway to Darjeeling, Kalimpong, Gangtok, and the Dooars builds a real hill-tourism economy on top of it.

It is building the kind of high-value skill portfolio that unlocks high income opportunities and moves you toward earlier financial freedom - whether that plays out from Siliguri or after a move to Kolkata.
